Papua New Guinea is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a trip to Papua New Guinea, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Papua New Guinea depends on what you want to experience. Summer offers long days perfect for outdoor adventures.

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Papua New Guinea is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Public transport in Papua New Guinea is efficient and affordable, making it easy to explore without a car.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts and budget hostels coexist in Papua New Guinea, giving travelers plenty of options.
